posts.title: CRYSTAL KAI KARATE TOURNAMENT 2026
posts.text: The CRYSTAL KAI KARATE TOURNAMENT 2026 was successfully held on 23rd August 2026 at the Noida Indoor Stadium, with close to 200 enthusiastic karate students participating in the event. The tournament provided a vibrant platform for young athletes to showcase their skills, discipline, confidence and competitive spirit.  Participants competed in various Kata and Kumite categories, displaying remarkable dedication and sportsmanship. The event celebrated the core values of karate—discipline, respect, perseverance and excellence.  The tournament was organised by *SENSEI SANDHIR N S BANERJEI and SENSEI RINI JOHNSON of CRYSTAL KAI KARATE CLUB,* whose dedicated efforts contributed to the smooth and successful conduct of the championship.  *🏆 Team Championship Results*  🥇 1st Place: Noida Karate Academy — Sensei Rajkumar Saini  🥈 2nd Place: Negi's School of Martial Arts — Sensei Ankit Rai  🥉 3rd Place: A R K Japan Karate Academy — Sensei Akash Kanojiya  🏆 Best Team Trophy: Assisi Convent School, Noida — Sensei Sunil Bhati  The presence of distinguished guests, coaches, officials, parents and supporters added to the grandeur of the occasion. The outstanding performances of the participants were recognised with medals, trophies and certificates, making the tournament a memorable experience for everyone involved.  The CRYSTAL KAI KARATE TOURNAMENT 2026 was more than a competition—it was a celebration of karate, teamwork, dedication and the pursuit of excellence, and marked another important milestone in the efforts of Crystal Kai Karate Club to nurture and promote young martial artists.
